# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: auth-api.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: auth-api
  team: platform
  tier: critical
spec:
  type: api
  slos:
    latency-p95:
      target: 99.5
      window: 30d
    token-generation-latency:
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: auth-db
    type: database
    critical: true
  ownership:
    team: platform
